# Office for Rent in ADGM — Aegis Coworking

> Aegis Coworking - ADGM rents furnished private offices in Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) from AED 4,500 per month at Addax Tower, 3812, Al Reem Island, RT3, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. Dedicated desks are AED 1,150 and flexi desks AED 1,000 per month. Offices include a registered ADGM business address, 24/7 access, and leases registered on AccessRP.

This site (rentofficeabudhabiglobalmarket.online) is a one-page guide to renting office space in ADGM, published by Aegis Coworking, an office space provider and business centre in ADGM. Main website: https://www.aegiscoworking.ae

Last Updated: 2026-10-06

## Key facts

- Small private office (1–4 people): from AED 4,500 per month
- Medium (5–10) and Large (10–20+) private offices: priced by layout
- Dedicated desk: AED 1,150 per month (one-time AED 1,200 due-diligence fee)
- Flexi desk: AED 1,000 per month; day pass AED 100; virtual office from AED 292 per month
- Private offices include furniture, lockable storage, high-speed internet, 24/7 access, registered ADGM business address, cleaning, utilities and reception
- Leases 12–36 months, registered on AccessRP; no deposit, no admin or setup fees, free registration; ADGM government fees separate
- FSRA-regulated firms usually need physical premises such as a private office
- Location: 38th floor, Addax Tower, Al Reem Island — inside the ADGM jurisdiction (24.4989303, 54.4031693)
- Contact: +971 50 392 6316 · WhatsApp https://wa.me/971503926316 · contact@aegiscoworking.ae
- Viewings: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM
